title: Pulse
page_desc: Protection desk for this device. Watch-list rules are owned by this plugin only.
vpn_on: Protection is on. Stats below are live.
vpn_off: Protection is off. You can request start from this page; Android’s VPN dialog still appears.
control_hint: Start/stop is rate-limited to once every 15 seconds. Notifications at most once every 30 seconds.
alert_body: Sends a short notice if the local VPN disconnects or errors.
watch_hint: One domain per line. Applied as a plugin-owned rule (max 32). Open Rules to see the Plugin badge.
watch_on_body: When off, this plugin removes its own rule.
